title: The homeodomain transcription factor Irx5 establishes the mouse cardiac ventricular repolarization gradient.
access_level: Primary abstract and NCBI metadata verified. EPMC fullTextXML returns500 for this non-OA author manuscript; NCBI PMC efetch provides front matter/abstract only. Publisher endpoint blocked in current environment. Do not claim the full original results/methods were read.
primary_findings: Mouse Irx5 loss abolishes the ventricular repolarization gradient through increased Kv4.2 expression in endocardial myocardium and increased fast transient outward K current Ito,f.
Irx5 shows an inverse myocardial gradient to Kv4.2 and recruits the mBop transcriptional corepressor to repress Kv4.2.
The knockout model has increased susceptibility to arrhythmias; the paper is mechanistic electrophysiology, not a single-cell transcriptomic classifier.
short_exact_abstract_quotes: Myocardial Irx5 is expressed in a gradient opposite that of Kv4.2
Irx5 represses Kv4.2 expression by recruiting mBop, a cardiac transcriptional repressor.

gene_mapping.role: Regulator; endomyocardial-high gradient in the established mouse model; inverse to Kv4.2/Ito,f.
Pore-forming fast transient outward potassium-current component; higher epicardial expression in established mouse gradient.
Corepressor recruited by Irx5; not itself a demonstrated opposite-gradient marker in the abstract.
Auxiliary subunit; explicitly supported by the2022 primary follow-up, not claimed as a core result from the2005 abstract alone.

follow_up_primary.title: Irx5 and transient outward K+ currents contribute to transmural contractile heterogeneities in the mouse ventricle.
follow_up_primary.findings: Irx5 knockout increases Kcnd2 and Kcnip2 expression in ENDO but notEPI, reduces endocardial shortening/Ca transients; Kv4.2 knockout instead increases epicardial shortening/Ca transients. Supports an electromechanical, not merely molecular, axis.

related_review.title: Transmural gradients in ion channel and auxiliary subunit expression.
related_review.scope: Regional and species-dependent channel/auxiliary-subunit gradients; source abstract verified.

application_to_current_postnatal_data: Test a signed repolarization axis: Irx5 versus Kcnd2/Kcnip2, not one unsigned average of all genes.
Evaluate each of P0/P7/P14/P21 and both original libraries separately; channel maturation may dominate across-age patterns.
Irx5/Smyd1 transcripts and Kcnd2/Kcnip2 RNA do not measure channel assembly, Ito,f, action-potential duration or contractility.
The verified abstract does not specify the ages of mice, so do not claim the original gradient is already fully established atP0/P7.
These gradients do not automatically define discrete CM subtypes. Shared gene expression should remain transcriptomic evidence until spatial/electrophysiological validation.
Mouse Kv4.2 biology should not be transferred unchanged to human/dog/rat gradients where Kcnd3/Kcnip2 contributions can differ.
